title: Section 49 Registration Act — Effect of non-registration

content.overview: An unregistered document required to be registered under section 17 or the Transfer of Property Act cannot affect immovable property, confer a power to adopt, or be received as evidence of the transaction, subject to a limited proviso.
content.study: Section 49 is the enforcement tooth of compulsory registration. The proviso still allows the unregistered instrument as evidence of a contract in a specific-performance suit, or of a collateral transaction not required to be effected by registered instrument. Link to TPA section 54 and SRA specific performance.
